title.narrative: Programme Costs for Economic Empowerment of the Poorest Programme

description.narrative: This activity Programme Costs for Economic Empowerment of the Poorest Programme is a component of Economic Empowerment of the Poorest reported by FCDO with a funding type of 111 - Not for profit organisation and a budget of £62,094,183. It works in the following sector(s): Rural development, Social Protection, Urban development and management, Environmental policy and administrative management.
